description: superdev hooks: force-injects the single using-superdev manifest at session start; gates ExitPlanMode on the plan declaring its format (SimplePlan / SuperPlan; defaults to SimplePlan), on the plan declaring its own file path (a 'Plan:' line naming itself), and on the plan reviewer's (superplan-reviewer / simpleplan-reviewer) VERDICT: PASS; on that allow it also records the approved plan's sha256 beside the plan file (<plan>.sha256) for decompose.sh to verify before building; an ExitPlanMode call whose plan argument opens with the marker 'superdev:routing-exit' is a routing exit (intent / superspec / phases / vibe leaving plan mode), allowed unconditionally and recording nothing.
